> Title this PR as a Conventional Commit, e.g. `feat(gcp): add Cloud Workflows mapping`.
> It becomes the release note and is checked by CI.

## What this changes

## Type of change

- [ ] New resource mapping / icon
- [ ] New or improved relationship inference
- [ ] New cloud provider
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Layout or rendering change
- [ ] Docs / tooling
- [ ] Icon set refresh

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title and commit messages (`npm run commitlint`)
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` passes (CI enforces ≥90% line coverage per file)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Added or updated a test for parsing/hierarchy changes
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
- [ ] No real plan, state file, account id or credential in the diff
- [ ] Screenshot or rendered SVG attached for visual changes
